verdict.rationale: LM Studio is primarily a local LLM runtime and server platform, so shipping an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence only shows LM Studio acting as an MCP client: it installs and connects MCP servers for use with local models. That client role does not count toward this story, and nothing documents LM Studio exposing its own official MCP server for external agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
